text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 17px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #23313d

g.text: A surface point on a rotating shaft sees reversed bending even under a steady transverse load

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #59636c

g.text: Assigned stress history at a material point on a rotating shaft with stationary-direction bending and steady transmitted torque. Bending stress reverses
each turn; torsional shear remains constant in the shaft material frame. Any varying torque or axial load requires its own mean and alternating components.
Fatigue criteria and stress concentrations are additional steps.
